question: was the memory structure from HJP-limited/sojung@feature/runtime-multiturn-summary ported correctly?
verdict: PORTED AND SUPERSEDED — every concept has a home, one is implemented differently on purpose, nothing was silently dropped

field_mapping.ours: actions: List<TrackedAction> with openActions / actionMemory / action(turnId) derived
field_mapping.status: RESHAPED — one typed list with a status instead of two untyped ones; the open/closed split survives as a derived view

field_mapping.ours: not stored; ModelContextSelector.renderDigest() derives it per request from transcript turns not already used by relevant_history or recent_conversation
renderSessionState() filters actions to open + last CLOSED_ACTION_LIMIT closed, and always excludes the turn being executed
field_mapping.status: RESHAPED — the branch hid all action bookkeeping from the model; ours shows verified open/closed state but never the live turn

field_mapping.ours: selectedContact: ContactReference (cardId + provenance + selection + confirmedAt, no PII)

reducer_parity.status: DIFFERENT VALUE — ours truncates each digest line harder because the digest is rebuilt per request rather than accumulated

digest_difference.branch: eviction-driven. recentMessages is a fixed window; when it overflows the evicted messages are appended to ConversationMemory.historyDigest via mergeHistoryDigest(), each message truncated at 500 chars, the whole string tail-trimmed to maxHistoryDigestChars. The digest is state and grows lossily.
digest_difference.ours: selection-driven. The full transcript is kept; every request picks recent turns, then relevant turns, then renders everything left over as the digest (DIGEST_MESSAGE_CHARS = 160 per line, tail-trimmed to budget.maxDigestChars). Nothing is stored, so nothing accumulates.
digest_difference.consequence_1: ours cannot show the same turn twice — relevant_history, recent_conversation and history_digest are disjoint by construction (a property CLAUDE.md states as a requirement)
digest_difference.consequence_2: ours has no eviction, so a turn that scrolled out of the window can still be selected back into relevant_history later; the branch could not recover an evicted message except as digest text
digest_difference.consequence_3: the branch's digest is part of memory state and would be persisted with it; ours is a rendering concern only
digest_difference.why: the section still exists and is still fed; only the production mechanism changed, and the change removes the duplication the branch's design allowed

not_ported_and_why.reason: replaced by per-request derivation; keeping the field would give two sources of truth for the same section
ours keeps the transcript and selects per request; CLAUDE.md explicitly forbids trimming the on-screen transcript for model-context reasons
the same intent is enforced at render time in renderSessionState(), which additionally excludes the in-flight turn

note_on_those_modules: none of them holds memory state; agent-routing is gateway/parsing, the others are runner/packaging. Their absence does not affect memory parity.
